data: 48 expanded-discovery contexts:24noun pairs, both numbers, first near-template attractor; no test states
design: Within each grammatical number, Cartesian24recipient x24source directions. Combined five-source delta normalized to one pooled discovery median norm. Four fixed random unit directions shared across recipients. Signed scales +/-0.25,+/-1. Recipient native prefix/context stays fixed.
limits: Transplanted residual edits may be off manifold. Discovery-only descriptive factorial, no learned predictor or new generalization claim. Same-number donors control effect sign; recipient context includes its own lexical state, not only attention routing.
